content: I am currently writing slides for a talk and I have noticed that the infoview displays random looking information when clicking on anything that is not a tactic, for example if I click on a variable X the infoview displays the docstring for IsPicardLindelof. The verso-slides version is "v4.33.0-rc1"
Nevermind, the issue is somewhere else: it seems that firefox is caching some of the information and does not reload the data on refresh. in private mode everything is fine
